item.title: I Built a Web Server in C and Hosted My Hugo Blog on It — Chaos Ensued
Linked List
item.description: Here I am 👋, it’s been 5 months or so since i wrote my first blog and this is my second. Yeah that’s my level of productivity 😶‍🌫️. In my second semester I have data structures which to me it is hard to grasp, at least these linked lists. So, in this blog I’m going deep into the linked lists (not so deep).
